text:
Maria: Quick thought — can we shift weekly triage from Thu 11:00 to Wed 09:30 and introduce a short "RFC lightning" slot (max 3 quick items) to speed reviews?

Sam: Wed 09:30 fine for me. What's the exact timebox for lightning?

Lee: 09:30 is better. Suggest 3m present + 2m quick Qs per item, no deep dives.

Ash: +1 but require pre-read. If folks don't read, lightning becomes long.

Maria: Proposed agenda (strict timings):
```
- 5m: ops / urgent notes
- 20m: bug queue triage (owners confirm or reassign)
- 10m: RFC lightning (3x3m + buffers)
- 10m: rollout notes / canary checks
- 5m: actions & owners
```
Total ~50m. We aim to start on time and close in 50.

triage-bot: Reminder: recurring event currently Thu 11:00. Organizer change pending; attendees will be updated.

Peter: Two asks: 1) reserve a 5m "Emergent bug" marker in the agenda if a Sev2 shows up, and 2) auto-assign any bug >72h with no owner to on-call pool.

Ash: For (1) we can use the ops slot to escalate, but a labeled emergent lane would help triage flows. For (2) agree — auto-assign policy would reduce trashing.

Sam: I'll update the Confluence triage page and add a checkbox in the invite linking to PR/issue and short summary.

Maria: Pre-read checklist (to be pasted in invite):
```
- 1-line summary
- 3 bullets: tradeoffs
- PR/issue link
- Expected ask: decision / input needed
- Attach diagram if helpful (optional)
```
Keep it skimmable for 2-3 minutes.

Lee: Can we trial this new format for 4 weeks and then review attendance & number of lightning items cleared? If no improvement, revert.

Maria: Will add a 4-week review slot and a quick async pulse survey after each meeting to capture whether lightning cleared blockers.

Peter: Please add a one-line note in the invite: "Bring context only; avoid full walkthroughs. If you need >10m, book a follow-up." That'll help discipline.

Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

Maria: Next steps: (1) change calendar to Wed 09:30, (2) paste agenda + pre-read into invite, (3) set 4-week review. Ping me by EOD if you object.

Ash: No objections. Thanks for coordinating.

Lee: Works for me.

Maria: Done — updated invite and posted a short note in #eng. :rocket:
